summary: The note argues that SMEs must cultivate a digital culture through training and development to stay competitive. It uses many company examples and survey statistics to show gains in productivity, efficiency, sales and ROI. It also covers the digital skills gap, tailored training, leadership, government incentives, education partnerships and measuring training impact.
one_line: Digital skills training helps SMEs raise productivity, sales and ROI, supported by leadership, tailored programs, government incentives and measurement.
key_facts: On September 15, 2023, Bloomtech Solutions CEO Eleanor Tran announced a plan to train the firm's 150 employees in the latest digital tools and practices.
The 'Global SME Digital Transformation Survey' (October 10, 2023) found 72% of respondents had increased training budgets to support digital literacy.
A TechGrowth Inc. study shared on November 2nd found SMEs investing in digital literacy saw a 40% rise in productivity.
Anderson Manufacturing Co., an automotive parts maker, trained staff in advanced analytics and machine learning; Mark Anderson said inventory costs fell 20% and delivery times improved 30%.
SkillSmart Analytics research (September 25, 2023) found nearly 65% of SMEs had difficulty finding candidates with the requisite digital skills.
Harper & Finch, an e-commerce company, built in-house training programs to upskill current employees; cofounder Sarah Finch said this filled the skills gap and retained top talent.
Tailored Tech Training Ltd. CEO Michael Stewart said on January 5, 2024 that clients see an average 35% increase in operational efficiency after specialized training.
Lexi Apparel, a small fashion brand, trained staff on CRM software and online marketing and reported 50% growth in online sales within six months.
A 'Financial Insights for SMEs' report (February 20, 2024) found each dollar spent on digital skill training returned an average of three dollars over two years.
Ben Harper, CEO of Harper Digital Dynamics, said at the 'Leaders in Technology Summit' on March 3, 2024 that SME scalability depends on leadership vision and commitment to continuous learning.
The Department of Industry and Technology launched the 'Digital SME Growth Fund' on November 15, 2023, offering grants and tax incentives for SMEs building workforce digital capabilities.
On February 4, 2024, MetroTech Community College partnered with local SMEs on internship programs giving students hands-on digital project experience.
Quantum Analytics Group founder Carlos Gomez said clients with a data-driven approach to training saw a clear correlation between skilling their workforce and growth metrics.
